text:
alex: Heads-up — ACME SI onboarding next week. We need a clear handoff for SOC reports, pen-test artifacts, and the public announcement cadence. Who owns which artifacts?

maria: I can take SOC2 report collection and redaction checklist. Need contact at ACME for signed attestation.

sam: I'll own pen-test artifacts + vuln-scan logs. Question: do we require raw scan exports or just signed summary PDFs?

alex: Prefer raw scan exports + signed summary for auditability. But we can redact PII in raw exports. Maria + Sam to coordinate redaction rules.

olivia: devsec-bot said last time partner SI asked for presigned S3 uploads. Suggest we provide a 7-day presign window and staged folder: /acme/onboard/{artifact_type}/.

ben: +1 on staged folders. Also recommend we include a small checklist for SI: expected filenames, max file sizes, and a GPG fingerprint for signing.

maria: I'll draft the checklist. Quick Q: does marketplace listing require a separate 'attestation' doc beyond SOC2?

alex: Yes — marketplace wants a short attestation statement (one page) saying scope / env used in SOC2 + pen test. Legal will sign.

sam: Timeline ask: ACME wants joint announcement 3 weeks after onboarding. We should set an internal freeze for redaction + QA at T+10 days. Can we commit?

alex: T+10 is tight but doable if partners respond quickly. Let's set these milestones: ingest window open Day 0–7, redaction/QA Day 8–12, legal attestation Day 13–14, announce Day 21.

olivia: I'll create the S3 presign role and generate a short runbook for engineers. Sample presign command (for SI):

```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-onboard/acme/onboard/pen-test/scan1.json --expires-in 604800
```

ben: Also adding note — pen-test reports need an accompanying CSV of repo hashes and a short mapping file for any infra scanned (so we can reproduce).

maria: Draft checklist link: https://redwood-internal/docs/onboard-checklist (will share editable copy).

devsec-bot: Reminder — ensure all artifacts stored under customer-approved retention policy. Retention key: acme-onboard-2026.

sam: One last ask: who is primary contact at ACME for upload issues?

alex: @olivia, pls confirm ACME contact. Olivia?

olivia: Confirmed — contact is jordan@acme-sis.com. I'll introduce and include the checklist + presign instructions.

ben: Great. I'll start the staging bucket and add IAM role. Will ping when ready. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks team — action items: Maria draft checklist, Sam prep scan export template, Ben create staging + IAM, Olivia intro to ACME. We'll reconvene T+4 days for status.

maria: noted. I'll aim to have draft by EOD tomorrow.

sam: same for templates.

ben: provisioning now, ETA 6 hours.

alex: closing — will post final timeline in #partnerships-ops when we have drafts.
